item.title: [New] Purview eDiscovery adds three read-only diagnostics for case access, security filters and hold-policy distribution
item.description:
During an investigation the usual eDiscovery failure is a case nobody can open or a hold that did not reach a mailbox; a built-in check shortens that triage without changing any setting.

Purview · Point the investigators who run eDiscovery cases at the new diagnostics once they appear; nothing to configure.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1515937 Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery: In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description:
Microsoft Purview eDiscovery introduces three read-only diagnostics for case access, security filters, and hold-policy distribution to help admins troubleshoot issues. Rolling out from October 2026 to February 2027 across environments. No admin action required; diagnostics do not alter configurations.

item.title: [New] Insider Risk Management alerts in Defender XDR slip from September 2026 to February 2027 (roadmap)
item.description:
A SOC that planned to correlate insider-risk alerts with Defender incidents and hunt them in KQL this autumn has to wait until February 2027 at the earliest; until then IRM stays a separate queue.

Purview · Keep the IRM-to-SOC hand-off as it is today and move any plan that assumed IRM alerts in the Defender incident queue to February 2027; when it ships, decide who may see de-anonymized IRM data in Defender before switching on the sharing setting.

item.title: [New] Sensitivity labels for Entra cloud security groups reach GA from mid-November; a label once applied cannot be changed or removed yet
item.description:
Security groups gate access to apps and resources; a label that sets guest access and cannot be removed is a one-way change on objects that Conditional Access and app assignments depend on.

Purview · Before labelling any security group, test on a throw-away group, decide which groups may carry a label, and restrict who can apply labels to groups.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Exchange Online DLP gains a 'Count of labeled documents is greater than' condition (preview November, GA December)
item.description:
Bulk sending of labeled files is a classic exfiltration pattern; a volume condition gives a DLP signal that content matching alone misses.

Purview · Plan a test rule in simulation mode with a threshold based on normal business volume once the preview reaches the tenant.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Teams meeting options will offer only the automatic recording and transcription choices the organizer's policy allows, and add 'Record only'
item.description:
Recording without a transcript becomes a one-click default, which changes what a compliance or eDiscovery search finds for a meeting.

Teams · Check which meeting policies allow recording but block transcription; tell organizers about 'Record only' if transcripts are relied on for retention.

item.title: [New] The October 2026 Scan Cab (wsusscn2.cab) is now available, a day late
item.description:
Offline compliance scans run since Patch Tuesday used the September cab and under-reported missing October updates; they can now be re-run.

Windows · Download the new wsusscn2.cab and re-run any offline compliance scan taken between 13 and 14 October.

item.title: [New] Purview DLP policies for Copilot, Copilot Chat and Cowork can be scoped to administrative units (roadmap, November 2026)
item.description:
Delegated DLP administration for AI surfaces means a regional admin can weaken Copilot protection for their unit without tenant-wide rights.

Purview · If you adopt AU-scoped DLP, audit Purview role assignments scoped to administrative units and alert on Copilot DLP policy edits.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Purview server-side auto-labeling will cover legacy .doc, .xls and .ppt files in SharePoint and OneDrive (roadmap, November 2026)
item.description:
Legacy binary Office files were a blind spot for auto-labeling, so sensitive content in old archives stayed unlabeled and invisible to label-based DLP.

Purview · When it ships, expect a jump in auto-labeling activity in the audit log and re-baseline label-change alerts.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1508238 Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra security groups
item.description:
Microsoft Purview will enable sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra cloud security groups starting mid-November 2026, allowing administrators to apply and enforce governance policies on these groups. Labels can be assigned via multiple platforms, cannot yet be changed once applied, and require separate tenant configuration from Microsoft 365 groups.

Microsoft 365 suite, Microsoft Purview · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1508235 Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Count of labeled documents condition for Exchange Online
item.description:
Microsoft Purview DLP introduces a new Exchange Online condition to detect emails with a high count of sensitivity-labeled attachments, enhancing data protection. Available from November 2026, it allows admins to set thresholds for labeled files in emails, combining volume and content signals for better DLP policy enforcement.
